exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch, then repeat.
tips: Keep shoulder blades pinned back and down on the pad the whole set.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the handle lines up with your mid-chest.
Press one handle forward while bracing with the free hand on the seat.
Lower slowly to a full stretch, finish all reps, then switch sides.
tips: Do not twist your torso toward the working arm; keep both shoulders on the pad.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press up and forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower under control until hands are level with your upper chest.
tips: Keep your chest up and lower back on the pad; avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Incline Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the handle starts at upper-chest height.
Press one handle up and forward, bracing with the other hand.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
tips: Keep hips and shoulders square; do not rotate to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Press forward and slightly down until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep elbows about 45 degrees from your body to protect the shoulders.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Chest Press
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles meet mid-chest.
Press both arms forward together or independently until almost locked out.
Lower slowly into a deep chest stretch and repeat.
tips: Load and unload both sides evenly so the machine does not tip or jerk.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Plate-Loaded Chest Press
steps: Load the working side and set the seat to mid-chest height.
Press one arm forward while holding the other handle or seat for support.
Lower to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your back flat on the pad and avoid rotating toward the working arm.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Incline Press
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles start at upper chest.
Press up and in until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly to a deep stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep wrists stacked over elbows; do not let the handles drift behind you.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Decline Press
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles meet your lower chest.
Press forward and down until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly and repeat.
tips: Stop the lowering phase where your shoulders still feel stable.

exercises.name: Wide Chest Press (Machine)
steps: Set the seat so the wide handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward, letting the handles converge, until arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly into a wide chest stretch and repeat.
tips: Do not let the elbows travel far behind the torso at the bottom.

exercises.name: Pec Deck / Machine Fly
steps: Set the seat so handles are at chest height with a slight elbow bend.
Bring the handles together in a wide hugging arc and squeeze.
Open slowly until you feel a chest stretch, then repeat.
tips: Keep the elbow angle fixed; do not turn the fly into a press.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Pec Deck Fly
steps: Sit facing forward and hold one handle at chest height.
Sweep that arm across to the midline and squeeze the chest.
Return slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Brace your free hand on the other handle or seat to stay square.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (High to Low)
steps: Set both pulleys high, grab the handles and step forward in a split stance.
Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Return slowly until your arms are wide and chest is stretched.
tips: Keep a soft fixed bend in the elbows and lean slightly forward.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (Low to High)
steps: Set both pulleys low and stand centered with handles at your sides.
Sweep your hands up and together to about chin height.
Lower slowly back to your sides with a chest stretch.
tips: Lead with the chest, not the shoulders; keep shoulders down.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Fly (Mid Height)
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and step forward in a split stance.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Open slowly to a full stretch and repeat.
tips: Do not let the weight pull your arms behind your shoulder line.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
steps: Set one pulley at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Sweep the handle across your body to the midline and squeeze.
Return slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your torso still; only the arm moves around the shoulder.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Cable Fly
steps: Place an incline bench between low pulleys and lie back with handles.
Bring the handles together above your upper chest in an arc.
Lower slowly until you feel a deep chest stretch.
tips: Keep the elbows slightly bent and stop before shoulder discomfort.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Chest Press
steps: Set pulleys at chest height, hold handles and step forward in a split stance.
Press both handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until hands are beside your chest.
tips: Brace your core so the cables do not pull you backward.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Chest Press
steps: Set one pulley at chest height and face away in a split stance.
Press the handle forward without rotating your torso.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
tips: Resist rotation; keep hips and shoulders facing forward.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Place a flat bench so the bar lowers to your mid-chest.
Unrack the bar and lower it slowly to touch your chest.
Press up until arms are straight, then rerack using the hooks.
tips: Set the safety stops just below chest level before you start.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
steps: Set an incline bench at 30 to 45 degrees so the bar meets your upper chest.
Unrack and lower the bar slowly to your upper chest.
Press up to straight arms and rerack when done.
tips: Set the safety stops so a failed rep cannot reach your neck.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Decline Press
steps: Set a decline bench so the bar lowers to your lower chest.
Unrack and lower the bar slowly to your lower chest.
Press up to straight arms and rerack when done.
tips: Hook your legs securely before unracking the bar.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Dip (Machine)
steps: Sit with handles beside your torso and lean your chest slightly forward.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly to a chest stretch and repeat.
tips: Lean forward and flare elbows slightly to bias the chest over triceps.

exercises.name: Pullover Machine
steps: Sit with shoulders aligned to the machine pivot and elbows on the pads.
Drive the elbows down in an arc until the bar reaches your stomach.
Return slowly overhead to a full lat stretch.
tips: Push through the elbows, not the hands, to keep tension on the lats.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
steps: Lock your thighs under the pad and grip the bar wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let the bar rise slowly until arms are fully extended.
tips: Do not lean far back or swing; keep the torso nearly upright.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Close Neutral Grip)
steps: Attach a close neutral-grip handle and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, elbows tight to your sides.
Return slowly to a full overhead stretch.
tips: Lead with the elbows and keep your chest tall.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Reverse Grip)
steps: Grip the bar palms facing you at about shoulder width.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows driving down and back.
Return slowly to straight arms.
tips: Keep wrists straight and avoid curling the bar with the biceps.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a D-handle to the high pulley and sit or kneel under it.
Pull the handle down to your side, driving the elbow toward your hip.
Return slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Let the shoulder rise at the top for a stretch, but do not twist.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Lat Pulldown
steps: Load plates evenly and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull both handles down until hands reach shoulder level.
Return slowly to a full stretch overhead.
tips: Pull the elbows down toward your ribs, not back behind you.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Plate-Loaded Pulldown
steps: Load the machine and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull one handle down, driving the elbow toward your hip.
Return slowly to a stretch, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Hold the other handle or pad to keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
steps: Attach a straight bar or rope high and hinge slightly forward.
Keep arms almost straight and sweep the bar down to your thighs.
Return slowly overhead until you feel the lats stretch.
tips: Keep elbows locked at a soft bend; the arms should not bend and press.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
steps: Set a D-handle high and stand facing the pulley, slightly hinged.
Sweep one straight arm down to your hip.
Return slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Finish with the hand slightly behind the hip to fully shorten the lat.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
steps: Select the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower slowly to straight arms and repeat.
tips: More weight on the stack means more help; reduce it as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Close Grip)
steps: Sit with feet on the platform, knees soft, holding a close-grip handle.
Row the handle to your stomach, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly, letting the shoulders reach forward.
tips: Keep a neutral spine; do not rock your torso to move the weight.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Wide Grip)
steps: Attach a wide bar and sit tall with feet on the platform.
Row the bar to your lower chest with elbows flared out.
Extend slowly to a full stretch and repeat.
tips: Pull the elbows out and back to target the upper back.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Single Arm)
steps: Attach a D-handle to the low pulley and sit tall.
Row the handle to your hip, driving the elbow back.
Reach forward slowly to a stretch, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Allow a small reach at the front but keep your torso from twisting hard.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
steps: Set the seat and chest pad so you just reach the handles.
Row the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not lean back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Seated Row (Machine)
steps: Set the chest pad and grab one handle.
Row it back toward your hip while your chest stays on the pad.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Brace the free hand on the pad or seat to prevent rotation.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Seated Row
steps: Load plates evenly and set the chest pad for a full reach.
Row both handles back until elbows pass your torso.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Pause one second at the squeeze before lowering.

exercises.name: High Row (Machine)
steps: Load plates, sit with thighs under the pad and grab the high handles.
Pull down and back until the handles reach your chest.
Return slowly up and forward to a stretch.
tips: Drive the elbows down toward your back pockets.

exercises.name: Single-Arm High Row (Machine)
steps: Load the machine, lock your thighs in and grab one handle.
Pull it down and back, elbow toward your hip.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your chest tall and avoid leaning toward the working side.

exercises.name: Low Row (Machine)
steps: Load plates and sit with chest on the pad, holding the low handles.
Row the handles back toward your hips.
Return slowly to a full forward reach.
tips: Pull in a low arc toward the hips to bias the lats.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
steps: Lie chest-down on the pad with feet on the platform and grab the handles.
Row the handles up until your elbows pass your torso.
Lower slowly to a full stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest glued to the pad; do not jerk off it.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Standing)
steps: Straddle the bar, hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab the handle.
Row the weight to your lower chest.
Lower under control without rounding your back.
tips: Keep a neutral spine and fixed hip angle throughout.

exercises.name: Standing Single-Arm Cable Row
steps: Set a D-handle at chest height and stand in a staggered stance.
Row the handle to your side, driving the elbow back.
Extend slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Brace your core to stop the cable twisting your torso.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
steps: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the bar shoulder width.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Set the safety stops near knee height.

exercises.name: Back Extension (45°)
steps: Set the pad just below your hip crease and lock your feet in.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Rise until your body forms a straight line, then repeat.
tips: Do not hyperextend at the top; stop in a straight line.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Horizontal / 90°)
steps: Lie face down with hips on the pad and heels hooked under the rollers.
Lower your torso toward the floor under control.
Raise back to a straight line and repeat.
tips: Cross your arms on your chest before adding weight.

exercises.name: Back Extension Machine (Seated)
steps: Sit with the back pad across your upper back and feet planted.
Push back against the pad until your torso is upright or slightly past.
Return slowly forward and repeat.
tips: Move smoothly; avoid throwing your weight back.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyper
steps: Lie face down with hips at the pad edge and ankles in the strap.
Swing your legs up until they line up with your torso.
Lower under control and repeat.
tips: Use the glutes to lift; do not snap the lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Face away from a low pulley holding a rope between your legs.
Hinge back at the hips until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall and squeeze the glutes.
tips: Hinge, do not squat; keep your shins nearly vertical.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at hip height with a shoulder-width grip.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs, back flat.
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward to stand.
tips: Keep the bar close and knees softly bent the whole time.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your back against the pad and do not arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handle starts at shoulder height.
Press one handle overhead while bracing with the other hand.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Do not lean away from the working arm to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Shoulder Press
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles are at shoulder level.
Press up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower under control to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your ribs down and your head against the pad.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set an upright bench so the bar passes just in front of your face.
Unrack and lower the bar to chin or upper-chest level.
Press up to straight arms and rerack when done.
tips: Set the safety stops above head height to protect your face.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Raise the pads out to the sides until your arms reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Lead with the elbows and keep the traps relaxed.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Sit with the working shoulder aligned to the pivot.
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Do not lean away; keep your torso upright on the seat.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise (Single Arm)
steps: Set the pulley low and stand side-on, holding the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly across your body, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Keep a slight elbow bend and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Cable Y-Raise
steps: Set both pulleys low and cross the cables, holding opposite handles.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape above shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.
tips: Use light weight and keep the shoulders down, away from the ears.

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Face away from a low pulley holding a bar or rope between your legs.
Raise the handle straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Do not lean back or swing to lift the weight.

exercises.name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Hold a straight bar or rope from a low pulley with a wide grip.
Pull up along your body until elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Stop at shoulder height to avoid pinching the shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit facing the pad with handles set at shoulder height.
Sweep the handles back in a wide arc until arms line up with your body.
Return slowly and repeat.
tips: Keep the elbows slightly bent and avoid pinching the shoulder blades hard.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit sideways or facing the pad and grab the opposite handle.
Sweep it back across your body until the arm is out to the side.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Let the arm cross your body at the start for a fuller stretch.
search: one arm rear delt fly machine

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at upper-chest or face height and hold it with thumbs toward you.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends past your ears.
Return slowly to straight arms.
tips: Finish with hands beside the head and elbows high for external rotation.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Fly (Crossover)
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold opposite cables with arms crossed.
Sweep your arms out and back until they line up with your body.
Return slowly to the crossed position.
tips: Hold the cable ends without handles if your grip takes over.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and grab the cable with the far hand.
Sweep the arm across and back until it points out to the side.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Keep your torso still and move only at the shoulder.
search: single arm rear delt fly cable

exercises.name: Shrug Machine
steps: Stand or sit under the pads and grip the handles with straight arms.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause, then lower slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Move straight up and down; do not roll the shoulders.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Hold the bar at thigh height with straight arms.
Shrug the shoulders up toward your ears.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Use straps if grip fails before the traps.

exercises.name: Cable Shrug
steps: Hold a straight bar from a low pulley, or two handles from both low pulleys.
Shrug the shoulders straight up.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep arms straight; do not bend the elbows to help.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl Machine
steps: Set the seat so your upper arms rest fully on the pad.
Curl the handles up until your forearms are near vertical.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep the back of your arms on the pad; do not lift the elbows.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Preacher Curl Machine
steps: Set the seat and rest one upper arm on the pad.
Curl the handle up and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Control the bottom; do not let the weight snap the elbow straight.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Preacher Curl
steps: Load plates and sit with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Curl the handles up until your forearms are near vertical.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
tips: Keep wrists neutral and avoid shrugging the shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Place a preacher bench facing a low pulley with a bar attached.
Curl the bar up with your arms on the pad.
Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.
tips: The cable keeps tension at the top; squeeze there for one second.

exercises.name: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Set a low pulley, face away and step forward so your arm trails behind you.
Curl the handle forward and up, keeping the elbow back.
Lower slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Do not let the elbow drift forward; the stretch behind you is the point.

exercises.name: Cable Curl (Straight Bar)
steps: Attach a straight or EZ bar to a low pulley and stand tall.
Curl the bar up while keeping elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
tips: Do not rock your hips to swing the bar up.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
steps: Attach a D-handle to a low pulley and stand facing it.
Curl the handle up, rotating the palm up as you lift.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Keep the elbow pinned to your side.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up, keeping elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
tips: Keep the wrists straight and the thumbs pointing up.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl (High Cable)
steps: Set both pulleys high and stand centered, arms out to the sides.
Curl the handles toward your ears, keeping upper arms level.
Extend slowly back out and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows at shoulder height the whole set.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl
steps: Hold a straight bar from a low pulley with palms facing down.
Curl the bar up, keeping elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
tips: Keep the wrists flat; do not let them bend back.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Sit or kneel facing a low pulley, forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Curl the bar up using only the wrists.
Lower slowly and let the bar roll toward your fingers.
tips: Keep forearms still; only the wrists move.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down, holding a low-pulley bar.
Raise the back of your hands using only the wrists.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Use light weight; the extensors are small muscles.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip Machine (Seated)
steps: Sit upright with handles beside your hips and elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until elbows are about 90 degrees.
tips: Stay upright and keep the elbows tucked to focus on the triceps.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip Machine
steps: Select the assistance weight, grip the dip bars and kneel on the pad.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
tips: Stay upright for triceps or lean forward for chest.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension Machine
steps: Sit with elbows on the pad, aligned with the machine pivot.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Return slowly until forearms are near your biceps.
tips: Keep your elbows on the pad and wrists neutral.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Triceps Extension Machine
steps: Sit with one elbow on the pad aligned with the pivot.
Extend that arm until straight.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Do not lift the elbow off the pad to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
steps: Attach a rope high and grab it with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down and split the rope ends at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly until forearms pass parallel.
tips: Keep the elbows still; only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (Straight / V-Bar)
steps: Attach a straight or V-bar high and grip it overhand.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until forearms are just above parallel.
tips: Stand tall and avoid leaning over the bar.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
steps: Attach a D-handle high and hold it with the elbow tucked.
Push down until your arm is straight.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Try both palm-down and palm-up grips to find what feels best.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Cable Pushdown
steps: Grip a straight bar from the high pulley with palms facing up.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly, keeping elbows fixed.
tips: Use lighter weight than a normal pushdown to protect the wrists.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension (Rope)
steps: Face away from the pulley holding a rope behind your head, elbows up.
Extend your arms forward and up until straight.
Return slowly to a deep stretch behind your head.
tips: Keep elbows pointing forward and close, not flaring out.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Set a pulley low, face away and hold the handle behind your head.
Extend the arm overhead until straight.
Lower slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Keep the upper arm still, beside your head.

exercises.name: Cable Cross-Body Triceps Extension
steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and hold the cable with the far hand.
Extend the arm across and out until it is straight.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the upper arm still at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
steps: Set a low pulley, hinge forward and hold the cable with elbow at your side.
Extend the arm back until straight.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Keep the upper arm parallel to the floor and still.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder width.
Lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press up to straight arms.
tips: Do not grip too narrow; shoulder width protects the wrists.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
steps: Stand with back and shoulders on the pads, feet shoulder width on the platform.
Release the handles and squat down as deep as you can control.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad; stop before it rounds off.

exercises.name: Reverse Hack Squat
steps: Face the machine with chest on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Sit back and down until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through the heels, squeezing the glutes.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad and avoid rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
steps: Stand on the platform with shoulders under the pads and back on the pad.
Release the safety and squat down deep in a smooth arc.
Push through the whole foot to return to the top.
tips: Let the knees travel forward; keep the heels down.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
steps: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Squat down, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up to standing and repeat.
tips: Great for loading legs without spinal compression; keep the belt snug.

exercises.name: V-Squat Machine
steps: Step under the shoulder pads facing the machine with feet on the platform.
Squat down as deep as you can control.
Drive through your whole foot back to the top.
tips: Keep your core braced and chest up throughout.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the bar on your upper back with feet slightly in front of the bar.
Unrack and squat down until thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up to standing and rerack when done.
tips: Set the safety stops just below your bottom position.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and take a long split stance.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through the front foot, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep most of the weight on the front foot.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up through the front foot, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Find your front foot position before unracking the bar.
search: rear foot elevated split squat smith

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet together.
Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return, alternating or finishing one side.
tips: Step back far enough that the front shin stays fairly vertical.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with upper back on a bench and the padded bar across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the bench.
Squeeze the glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your chin tucked and ribs down at the top.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Leg Press
steps: Sit with back flat on the pad and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the sled until knees are deeply bent.
Press the sled back up without locking your knees.
tips: Stop lowering before your lower back lifts off the pad.

exercises.name: Single-Leg 45-Degree Leg Press
steps: Place one foot in the center of the platform.
Lower the sled slowly until the knee is deeply bent.
Press back up, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the knee tracking over the toes; do not let it cave in.

exercises.name: Horizontal Leg Press
steps: Adjust the seat so knees start well bent, feet shoulder width on the plate.
Press the plate away until your legs are almost straight.
Return slowly to the start.
tips: Do not lock the knees at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Horizontal Leg Press
steps: Place one foot in the center of the plate.
Press until the leg is almost straight.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips flat on the seat.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
steps: Align your knees with the machine pivot and set the pad above your ankles.
Extend your legs until straight and squeeze the quads.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your hips down on the seat.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
steps: Set up as normal with one leg under the pad.
Extend that leg until straight.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Use about half your two-leg weight to start.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Align knees with the pivot, lock the thigh pad down and set the pad behind your ankles.
Curl your heels down and back as far as possible.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.
tips: Lean your torso slightly forward to stretch the hamstrings more.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Seated Leg Curl
steps: Set up as normal with one ankle on the pad.
Curl that heel down and back fully.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the working thigh firmly under the pad.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down with knees just off the pad and the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly to almost straight legs.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad; do not lift them.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down with one heel under the roller.
Curl that heel toward your glute.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep both hips flat on the pad.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Stand with the knee against the pad and the roller behind your ankle.
Curl the heel up toward your glute.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the hips still; do not swing the leg.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
steps: Lock your ankles in with knees just behind the pad.
Lower your body forward slowly, keeping hips straight.
Curl back up with the hamstrings until upright.
tips: Push off the floor with your hands at first if needed.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
steps: Sit with your upper back on the pad and the belt or pad over your hips.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes, then lower under control.
tips: Keep your shins vertical at the top for most glute work.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (Machine)
steps: Set up in the hip thrust machine and lift one foot off the platform.
Drive up through the planted foot until hips are level.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the pelvis level; do not let one side drop.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback Machine
steps: Set your chest or forearms on the pad and place one foot on the platform.
Push the leg back and up by extending the hip.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Do not arch your lower back to get extra range.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face the machine.
Kick the strapped leg straight back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Hinge slightly forward and keep the lower back neutral.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees out as far as you can control.
Return slowly without letting the stack touch.
tips: Leaning slightly forward shifts more work to the glutes.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
steps: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees, legs open to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet.
Open slowly and repeat.
tips: Set the starting width to a stretch you can control, not your maximum.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to the outside leg and stand side-on to a low pulley.
Lift the strapped leg out to the side.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso upright; do not lean away to lift higher.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Attach an ankle strap to the near leg and stand side-on to a low pulley.
Sweep the strapped leg across in front of the other leg.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Hold the machine for balance and keep hips square.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
steps: Step under the shoulder pads with the balls of your feet on the edge.
Rise up as high as possible onto your toes.
Lower slowly into a deep stretch and pause.
tips: Keep knees straight but not locked; pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
steps: Stand under the pads with one foot on the edge and the other lifted.
Rise as high as possible onto the toes.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Use the full range; the stretch at the bottom matters most.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and balls of the feet on the edge.
Release the safety and rise up onto your toes.
Lower slowly into a deep stretch and repeat.
tips: Bent knees shift the work to the soleus; go slow at the bottom.

exercises.name: Calf Press on Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press with only the balls of your feet on the platform edge.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Let it return slowly to a deep calf stretch.
tips: Keep the safeties on and never let your feet slip off the edge.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand on a step or plate.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a deep stretch.
tips: Use a stable step and set the safeties just below your start.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise Machine
steps: Bend forward at the hips with the pad on your lower back and feet on the edge.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a deep stretch.
tips: Keep knees almost straight to keep the gastrocnemius stretched.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
steps: Sit with the pads on your chest or the handles beside your head.
Curl your ribs toward your hips, rounding the spine.
Return slowly and repeat.
tips: Move by flexing the spine, not by pulling with your arms.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch (Kneeling)
steps: Kneel facing a high pulley, holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Return slowly to a stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips still; the movement comes from the spine.

exercises.name: Rotary Torso
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and lock your legs in.
Rotate your torso to one side under control.
Return slowly, finish reps, then set up for the other side.
tips: Use light to moderate weight and a pain-free range.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchopper (High to Low)
steps: Set a pulley high and stand side-on, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull diagonally down across your body to the opposite hip.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Rotate through the torso and pivot the back foot.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
steps: Set a pulley at chest height and stand side-on, handle at your chest.
Press the handle straight out and resist the pull to rotate.
Bring it back, finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Keep hips and shoulders square the whole time.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Rest forearms on the pads, back against the backrest, legs hanging.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
tips: Curl the hips up at the top to work the abs, not just the hip flexors.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Crunch
steps: Hook your feet under the rollers of a decline bench and lie back.
Curl your torso up until your back is off the bench.
Lower slowly, one vertebra at a time.
tips: Do not pull on your neck; cross your arms or hold a plate.

exercises.name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding the handle at your side.
Bend sideways away from the pulley, then toward it for a stretch.
Finish reps, then switch sides.
tips: Move only sideways; do not twist or lean forward.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with ankle straps attached to a low pulley behind you.
Curl your knees toward your chest, lifting the hips off the floor.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Lift the hips by curling the pelvis, not by swinging the legs.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Good Morning
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with knees softly bent.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back with a flat back.
Return to standing by driving the hips forward.
tips: Use light weight and stop when you feel your back start to round.

exercises.name: Multi-Hip Machine
steps: Set the pad height and stand with the pad against the working leg.
Move the leg back, out, in or forward depending on the target.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Stand tall and hold the handles; avoid leaning to cheat.

exercises.name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
steps: Face a low pulley holding a straight bar, standing a step back.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the bar along your legs with a flat back.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
tips: Keep the bar close to your legs and knees softly bent.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise (Two-Arm Crossover)
steps: Set both pulleys low, stand centered and hold opposite handles in front of you.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.
tips: Keep a slight bend in the elbows and do not shrug.

exercises.name: Machine Rear Delt Row
steps: Sit facing the chest pad and grip the wide handles overhand.
Row back with elbows flared out at shoulder height.
Return slowly to straight arms.
tips: Keep the elbows high and level with the shoulders.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Y-Raise
steps: Set a pulley low and hold the handle with the far hand across your body.
Raise the arm up and out on a Y angle above shoulder height.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Use light weight; keep the shoulder down, away from the ear.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
steps: Half-kneel beside a high pulley holding the D-handle overhead.
Pull the elbow down toward your hip.
Return slowly to a full stretch, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Keep your ribs down and torso tall throughout.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Plate-Loaded Row
steps: Load the machine, set your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Row it back until the elbow passes your torso.
Return slowly, finish reps, then switch arms.
tips: Brace the free hand on the pad to stop rotation.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Set the bar on your back and stand on a step with one foot.
Rise as high as possible onto the toes.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch legs.
tips: Pause in the stretch at the bottom of every rep.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Chest Press
steps: Set pulleys low and stand in a split stance, handles at chest level.
Press the handles up and forward to about eye level.
Return slowly to the chest.
tips: Keep the ribs down so the lower back does not arch.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Fly (Bench)
steps: Place an upright bench between pulleys set at shoulder height and sit.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in an arc.
Open slowly to a full chest stretch.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and elbows softly bent.

exercises.name: Single-Arm High Cable Curl
steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and hold the handle with arm out to the side.
Curl the handle toward your head, keeping the upper arm level.
Extend slowly, finish reps, then switch.
tips: Keep the elbow at shoulder height; do not let it drop.

exercises.name: Lying Cable Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your head toward a low pulley, holding a bar.
Curl the bar toward your forehead, upper arms vertical.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
tips: Keep the upper arms still and pointing up.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension (Bar, Seated)
steps: Sit on a bench facing away from a low pulley, holding an EZ bar overhead.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back up until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep a back pad behind you so you stay upright.

exercises.name: Cable Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a rope or handle from a low pulley at your chest and step back.
Squat down between your knees with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
tips: Lean back slightly against the cable to stay balanced.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat Machine
steps: Lock your ankles in and rest your calves against the pad.
Lean back and bend your knees forward, lowering your body.
Push through the knees to return upright.
tips: Keep hips straight in line with your torso throughout.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Bench Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lie on the bench with the handles in line with your mid chest.
Grip the handles, brace, and press until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest, then press again.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and your feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Horizontal Bench Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lie back on the bench and line the handles up with your lower chest.
Press the handles up and slightly together until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower under control to a deep chest stretch and repeat.
tips: Do not let your lower back arch off the pad as you press.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Incline Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start level with your upper chest.
Press up and out until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until your hands are just above shoulder level, then press.
tips: Keep your back flat on the pad and do not shrug your shoulders up.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Super Incline Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your back on the steep pad and handles near your upper chest.
Press up until your arms are nearly straight without locking out hard.
Lower under control to the start and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest up and ribs down so the lower back stays on the pad.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Decline Chest Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Press forward and slightly down until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch, then press again.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and stacked over your forearms.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Wide Chest (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit upright and set the seat so the handles are at mid chest height.
Press the wide handles forward and together until arms are nearly straight.
Let the handles come back wide for a deep stretch, then press.
tips: Only go as deep as your shoulders stay comfortable; do not force the stretch.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Chest / Back (Hammer Strength)
steps: For chest, sit facing out, grip the press handles and press forward.
For back, use the pulldown handles and pull your elbows down to your sides.
Control each rep back to the start before the next one.
tips: Set the seat for each exercise; the right height differs for press and pulldown.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Super Fly (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and grab the handles at your sides.
With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of you.
Open back slowly until you feel a chest stretch, then squeeze again.
tips: Keep the elbow bend fixed; do not turn the fly into a press.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Shoulder Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level and repeat.
tips: Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Lateral Raise (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and arms against the arm pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.
tips: Lead with the elbows and do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Rear Deltoid (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lie chest down on the angled pad with the arm pads against your upper arms.
Push your arms back and out until they are in line with your body.
Return slowly to the start and repeat.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not lift your torso to swing the weight.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Front Lat Pulldown (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pad and reach up to the handles.
Pull your elbows down and back until your hands reach upper chest level.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
tips: Drive with the elbows and keep your torso still; do not lean back to cheat.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Wide Pulldown (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with thighs locked under the pad and take the wide handles.
Pull down and out until your hands reach shoulder level.
Return slowly to a full stretch overhead.
tips: Keep your chest tall and shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral High Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and reach up and forward to the handles.
Pull the handles down and back toward your lower chest.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
tips: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of each pull.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Row the handles back until your elbows pass your torso.
Let your arms extend slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not rock backward to move the weight.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Low Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and reach forward to the low handles.
Pull the handles back toward your hips, keeping elbows close.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Think of pulling your elbows to your back pockets to hit the lats.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral D.Y. Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with chest on the pad and grab the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles back and down in an arc toward your hips.
Let them return slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked and avoid shrugging during the pull.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral T-Bar Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the platform, chest on the pad, and grip the handles.
Row the handles up toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep a flat back and soft knees throughout the set.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the foot platform, chest on the pad, and grab the handles.
Pull the lever arm up toward your chest.
Lower under control to a full arm stretch.
tips: Brace your core and keep your neck in line with your spine.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Pullover (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivot.
Place your arms on the pads and pull them down in an arc toward your waist.
Let your arms rise slowly back overhead to a full stretch.
tips: Push with your elbows and upper arms, not your hands.

exercises.name: Seated / Standing Shrug (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit or stand between the handles and grip them with straight arms.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Do not roll your shoulders; move straight up and down.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Seated Biceps (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your upper arms flat on the pad and elbows at the pivot.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad; do not lean back to lift.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Seated Dip (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and grip the handles at your sides.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let them rise slowly until your elbows bend to about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and back; stop if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Gripper (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and place your hands around the grip handles.
Squeeze the handles together as hard as you can.
Open your hands slowly to the start and repeat.
tips: Use a full squeeze and slow release; avoid jerking the handles.

exercises.name: Abdominal / Oblique Crunch (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit, secure your feet, and hold the handles near your shoulders.
Curl your torso down by bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly; twist slightly to one side to work the obliques.
tips: Move from the abs, not by pulling with your arms.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded 4-Way Neck (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and place your head against the pad facing the direction you will train.
Move your head slowly against the pad through a small range.
Return slowly, then turn the seat to train the next direction.
tips: Use light weight and slow, controlled reps; never jerk the neck.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Linear Leg Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit back in the seat with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the rack handles and lower the sled by bending your knees.
Press back up without locking your knees, then re-rack at the end.
tips: Keep your lower back and hips on the pad at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Leg Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit in the seat and place your feet on the two separate footplates.
Press the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Lower slowly until your knees bend deeply, then press again.
tips: Train one leg at a time to fix side-to-side strength gaps.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Hack Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Release the racking handles and squat down as deep as you can control.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
tips: Keep your knees tracking over your toes and your back flat on the pad.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Linear Hack Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Step in with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Flip out the racking handles and lower into a deep squat.
Press back up and flip the handles in to rack.
tips: Set the range limiter so the carriage cannot drop lower than you can control.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded V-Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the platform with your shoulders under the pads.
Lower your hips back and down along the machine's arc.
Drive up through your heels to the top.
tips: Keep your chest up and let your hips travel back as you descend.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Reverse V-Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the foot platform, then step in and place your shoulders under the pads.
Squat down along the arc as deep as you can control.
Press through the platform to stand back up.
tips: Facing in shifts work to the quads; facing out shifts it to the glutes.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Pendulum-X Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and swing down into a deep squat.
Drive up through your mid-foot to the top.
tips: Use the full depth only if your lower back stays on the pad.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Super Squat Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set your back on the fixed pad and feet on the foot platforms.
Release the rack and lower by bending your knees and hips.
Press back up with one or both legs, then re-rack.
tips: The work arms move independently, so press evenly unless training one leg.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Belt Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand on the platform and attach the belt around your hips.
Release the lever and squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
tips: Hold the handles for balance only; let your legs do the work.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Leg Extension (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your knees lined up with the machine pivot and shins behind the pads.
Straighten your legs until your knees are fully extended.
Lower slowly until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
tips: Hold the side handles and keep your hips down on the seat.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Leg Curl (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad and ankles under the rollers.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad; do not lift them to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl (Hammer Strength)
steps: Kneel on the knee pad with your forearms on the support and ankle under the roller.
Curl your heel up toward your glute.
Lower slowly to a straight leg, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips square and avoid twisting to lift more weight.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Assisted Nordic Ham (Hammer Strength)
steps: Kneel on the pad with your ankles locked under the rollers.
Lower your body forward slowly, keeping hips straight, as the machine assists.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.
tips: Keep a straight line from knees to head; do not bend at the hips.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Glute Drive (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your upper back on the pad and the hip pad across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower slowly and repeat.
tips: Tuck your chin and ribs down so you extend with the glutes, not the lower back.

exercises.name: Glute Ham / Reverse Hyper (Hammer Strength)
steps: For reverse hyper, lie face down with hips at the pad edge and ankles in the strap.
Swing your legs up until they line up with your torso.
Lower under control; use the glute-ham side for raises with ankles locked.
tips: Lift with the glutes and avoid swinging the legs with momentum.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Seated Calf Raise (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and thighs under the pad.
Release the lock and lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can, pause, and lower.
tips: Pause at the bottom stretch; do not bounce.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Tibia Dorsi-Flexion (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and hook the tops of your feet under the foot pad.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as far as you can.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
tips: Use a light load and full range; this is a small muscle.

exercises.name: Ground Base Squat / High Pull (Hammer Strength)
steps: For squats, stand under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are about parallel, then drive up.
For high pulls, grip the handles low and pull up explosively to chest height.
tips: Keep your back flat and chest up in both movements.

exercises.name: Ground Base Jammer (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand between the arms in a slight squat and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Drive up with your legs and press the handles up and forward.
Lower the handles back to your shoulders under control.
tips: Brace your core so the force travels from your legs to your arms.

exercises.name: Ground Base Combo Twist (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand facing the machine and hold the handle with both hands at chest height.
Rotate through your hips and torso to move the arm across to one side.
Return under control and rotate to the other side.
tips: Pivot your back foot and turn from the hips, not just the lower back.

exercises.name: Ground Base Multi-Squat (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand inside the frame in an athletic stance and grip the high handles.
Squat down with your chest up until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up to standing; use the low handles for RDLs or deadlifts.
tips: Keep a neutral spine, especially on hinge moves with the low handles.

exercises.name: Ground Base Combo Incline (Hammer Strength)
steps: Stand in a split stance and hold the handles near your shoulders.
Press up and forward on an incline, driving from your legs.
Lower under control and press with the other arm or both arms.
tips: Keep your core tight so you do not twist more than the machine allows.

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Vertical Smith Machine (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the bar at the right rack height for your lift and load both sides evenly.
Get under or behind the bar, twist it to unhook, and do your squat, press or lunge.
Twist the bar back onto the nearest hook to rack it.
tips: Set the safety stops just below your lowest point before you start.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Assist Dip Chin
steps: Pick the assist weight; more weight means more help.
Kneel or stand on the assist pad and grip the chin or dip handles.
Pull up until chin clears the bar, or dip down and press up, then lower slowly.
tips: Lower slowly; the eccentric part builds the most strength.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Biceps Curl
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot and arms rest on the pad.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
tips: Keep your elbows on the pad throughout each rep.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Chest Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly to a chest stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades back and your back on the pad.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Fixed Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and grip the fixed handles.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Let them rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep your chest up and pull with your elbows, not your hands.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and grab the bar wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while leaning back slightly.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Do not pull the bar behind your neck.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Lateral Raise
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot points.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly to the start.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Seated Row
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Row the handles back until your elbows pass your sides.
Extend your arms slowly to the start.
tips: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of every rep.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height.
Press overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.
tips: Keep your back on the pad; do not arch to finish the press.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Pectoral Fly/Rear Deltoid
steps: For pec fly, sit facing out and bring the handles together in front of you.
For rear delt, sit facing the pad and push the handles back and out.
Return slowly each rep; reset the arm start position when you switch.
tips: Keep a soft bend in your elbows that does not change during the rep.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Pectoral Fly
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and grab the handles at chest height.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Open slowly to a comfortable chest stretch.
tips: Do not let the handles pull your shoulders back past a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Triceps Extension
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot and arms rest on the pad.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows bend about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your upper arms still on the pad; only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Abdominal Crunch
steps: Sit with feet secured and hold the handles or pads near your chest.
Crunch forward by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly to upright.
tips: Breathe out as you crunch and do not yank with your arms.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Back Extension
steps: Sit with your upper back against the pad and feet on the footplate.
Extend backward until your torso is upright or slightly past.
Return slowly forward to the start.
tips: Move slowly and do not throw yourself back into hyperextension.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Hip Abduction
steps: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees out as far as you comfortably can.
Bring them back together slowly.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and avoid letting the weight stack slam.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Hip Adduction
steps: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees and set the start width.
Squeeze your knees together.
Open slowly back to the start.
tips: Pick a start width that stretches but does not strain your groin.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Hip and Glute
steps: Set up with your working foot or leg against the pad as shown on the placard.
Drive the leg back by squeezing your glute until the hip is straight.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your lower back neutral; do not arch to push further.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Horizontal Calf
steps: Sit back with the balls of your feet on the footplate and legs nearly straight.
Push through your toes to extend your ankles fully.
Let your heels come back slowly for a deep stretch.
tips: Keep your knees soft but still; only the ankles move.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down with knees just past the pad and ankles under the roller.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly until legs are almost straight.
tips: Keep your hips down on the pad throughout.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit with knees at the pivot, lower the thigh pad, and put ankles on the roller.
Pull your heels down and back under the seat.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.
tips: Lock the thigh pad snug so your hips do not lift.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Leg Extension
steps: Sit with knees lined up with the pivot and shins behind the roller.
Straighten your legs fully.
Lower slowly until knees bend about 90 degrees.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Seated Leg Press
steps: Set the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees with feet on the plate.
Press the footplate away until legs are nearly straight.
Return slowly to the start.
tips: Do not lock your knees at the top.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Select Standing Calf
steps: Stand under the shoulder pads with the balls of your feet on the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step for a full stretch.
tips: Keep your knees straight but not locked.

exercises.name: MTS Abdominal Crunch (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit, secure your feet, and grip the handles overhead or at your shoulders.
Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly to upright.
tips: Exhale as you crunch and keep tension on the abs at the top.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivots and arms rest on the pad.
Curl one or both handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
tips: Each arm has its own stack; keep the weaker arm from being carried.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Press forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly to a chest stretch.
tips: Press each arm evenly unless you are training one side on purpose.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Decline Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Press forward and down until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly to the start.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades back against the pad.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Incline Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper chest level.
Press up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.
tips: Keep your back flat on the pad and do not shrug.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Front Pulldown (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and reach up to the handles.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides.
Let the handles rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral High Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and reach up and forward to the handles.
Pull down and back toward your lower chest.
Return slowly to the start.
tips: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the pull.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Row (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab the handles.
Row back until your elbows pass your sides.
Extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad the whole set.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Shoulder Press (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press overhead until arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and core braced.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Triceps Extension (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivots and arms rest on the pad.
Extend the handles until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows bend about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad; only your forearms move.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Leg Extension (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit with knees lined up with the pivots and shins behind the pads.
Straighten one or both legs fully.
Lower slowly until knees bend about 90 degrees.
tips: Train each leg alone to find and fix a weaker side.

exercises.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl (Hammer Strength)
steps: Kneel on the pad with forearms supported and ankle under the roller.
Curl your heel up toward your glute.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square and do not twist to lift.

exercises.name: HD Elite iD Power Rack (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the J-hooks at upper chest height and safeties just below your squat depth.
Unrack the bar on your upper back, step back, and squat.
Walk the bar back in and set it on the hooks.
tips: Always set the safety arms before lifting heavy alone.

exercises.name: HD Elite Half Rack (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the J-hooks at upper chest height and spotter arms below your lowest point.
Unrack the bar, step back, and do your squat or press.
Step forward and rack the bar on both hooks.
tips: Check that both sides of the bar are on the hooks before letting go.

exercises.name: HD Elite Multi-Adjustable Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the back pad to flat, incline, or upright for your exercise.
Lie or sit with feet flat and press your dumbbells or bar.
Lower under control and repeat; recheck the pin lock between sets.
tips: Make sure the adjustment pin is fully locked before you load the bench.

exercises.name: Olympic Flat Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lie with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Unrack, lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press up to straight arms and rack when done.
tips: Use a spotter or safety for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Olympic Incline Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit back on the incline seat with the bar above your eyes.
Unrack and lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press up and back over your shoulders, then rack.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge to lift more.

exercises.name: Olympic Decline Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Hook your legs under the pads and lie back on the decline.
Unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press back up and rack the bar.
tips: Have a spotter hand you the bar; unracking from a decline is awkward.

exercises.name: Olympic Military Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit upright with your back on the pad and the bar just behind your head.
Unrack and lower the bar to chin or upper chest level.
Press overhead to straight arms, then rack.
tips: Press the bar in front of your face, not behind your neck.

exercises.name: Seated Arm Curl (Hammer Strength)
steps: Sit and rest the backs of your upper arms on the angled pad.
Curl the bar or dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until arms are almost straight.
tips: Do not drop into a full lockout at the bottom with heavy weight.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Back Extension
steps: Set the hip pad just below your hip bones and lock your ankles in.
Lower your torso forward with a flat back.
Raise up until your body is in a straight line, not past it.
tips: Squeeze your glutes at the top instead of over-arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Fixed Pad Glute/Ham (Hammer Strength)
steps: Lock your ankles in with knees just behind the pad.
Lower your torso forward slowly, keeping hips straight.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and glutes.
tips: Use your hands to push off the floor at first if you cannot do a full rep.

exercises.name: Adjustable Decline Bench (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the decline angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Lower slowly back down without letting your head drop.
tips: Start with a low angle and raise it as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Smith Machine (Hammer Strength)
steps: Set the safety stops just below your lowest point and load the bar evenly.
Twist the bar to unhook it and perform your squat, press, or lunge.
Twist the bar back onto a hook to rack it.
tips: Place your feet so the fixed bar path feels natural for your joints.

exercises.name: Converging Chest Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down the whole set.

exercises.name: Pectoral Fly (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the arms of the machine sit at chest height.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of you.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.
tips: Do not let your arms travel behind your body at the stretch.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Matrix)
steps: Sit facing the pad and set the seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Hold the handles with nearly straight arms and sweep them back.
Squeeze your upper back, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad and do not shrug.

exercises.name: Pectoral Fly / Rear Delt (Matrix)
steps: Set the arm start position for chest fly or for rear delt.
For fly, bring the handles together; for rear delt, face the pad and sweep back.
Control the return and keep a slight bend in the elbows.
tips: Change the arm setting before switching exercises, never mid set.

exercises.name: Converging Shoulder Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Place your arms on the pads and raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
tips: Lead with the elbows and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Diverging Lat Pulldown (Matrix)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down to upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Do not lean far back or swing the weight.

exercises.name: Diverging Seated Row (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid chest, chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not jerk with your lower back.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Triceps Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit beside your hips at the start.
Sit tall and push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot on the pad.
Straighten your elbows to push the handles away.
Return slowly without lifting your elbows.
tips: Only the forearms move; keep the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat, secure your feet and hold the handles or pads.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch forward.
Return slowly without letting the stack rest.
tips: Move from your spine; do not pull with your arms.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat and place the roller pad across your upper back.
Push back by extending your spine and hips.
Return slowly to the start position.
tips: Move smoothly and do not snap back at the top.

exercises.name: Rotary Torso (Matrix)
steps: Set the start range and sit with your knees against the pads.
Hold the handles and rotate your torso to one side.
Return slowly, then reset the machine for the other side.
tips: Rotate slowly; never swing into the end range.

exercises.name: Dip / Chin Assist (Matrix)
steps: Choose the assist weight; more weight gives you more help.
Kneel on the pad and do a pull-up or a dip.
Lower yourself slowly and under control.
tips: Step off the pad only when it is fully down.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Matrix)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees.
Place your feet shoulder-width on the plate and press away.
Stop short of locking your knees, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Matrix)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Matrix)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Lock the thigh pad down and place the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels under the seat, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your hips down against the seat.

exercises.name: Prone Leg Curl (Matrix)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad edge.
Place the roller above your heels and curl toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your legs on the pads at a comfortable wide start.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the stretched start.
tips: Pick a start width you can control, not your maximum split.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your outer thighs against the pads.
Push your knees outward as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly without letting the weights touch.
tips: Sit tall and do not rock your torso.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor / Adductor (Matrix)
steps: Set the pads for inner-thigh or outer-thigh mode.
Squeeze your legs in, or push them out, depending on the mode.
Return slowly and under control to the start.
tips: Switch modes only with the weight fully lowered.

exercises.name: Calf Extension (Matrix)
steps: Sit and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
With knees almost straight, push through your toes.
Let your heels come back slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Use the full range; pause briefly in the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute (Matrix)
steps: Set the chest pad, lean on it and hold the handles.
Place one foot on the plate and push back by extending your hip.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your lower back neutral; drive with the glute, not the spine.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your upper back on the pad and the hip pad across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Tuck your chin and ribs; do not arch your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Magnum Vertical Bench Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Load both sides evenly before you sit down.

exercises.name: Magnum Supine Bench Press (Matrix)
steps: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the handles.
Press the handles up to arm's length.
Lower slowly back to chest level.
tips: Keep your feet flat and your shoulder blades set.

exercises.name: Magnum Incline Bench Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press the handles up and forward with your back on the pad.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge.

exercises.name: Magnum Decline Pec Fly (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit at lower-chest height.
