With a slight elbow bend, sweep the handles down and together.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly to a comfortable stretch.
tips: Keep the elbow angle fixed; do not turn it into a press.

exercises.name: Magnum Shoulder Press (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Magnum Lat Pulldown (Matrix)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down toward your upper chest.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Drive with the elbows, not the hands.

exercises.name: Magnum Seated Row (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid chest, chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad the whole set.

exercises.name: Magnum T-Bar Row (Matrix)
steps: Stand on the foot platform, hinge forward and grip the handles.
Keep a flat back and row the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep a neutral spine; never round your lower back.

exercises.name: Magnum High Row (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so you reach the handles with arms up and forward.
Pull the handles down and back toward your sides.
Squeeze your back, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Magnum Low Row (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab the low handles.
Row the handles back toward your hips.
Squeeze your back, then let your arms extend slowly.
tips: Pull toward the hips to bias the lower lats.

exercises.name: Magnum Elevated Biceps Curl (Matrix)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Magnum Ab Crunch Bench (Matrix)
steps: Lie on the bench and grip the handles behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly without resting between reps.
tips: Do not yank with your arms or neck.

exercises.name: Magnum Smith Machine (Matrix)
steps: Set the bar height and the safety stops for your exercise.
Rotate the bar to unrack it, then squat or press.
Rotate the bar back onto the hooks to finish.
tips: Always set the safety stops just below your lowest point.

exercises.name: Magnum 45-Degree Leg Press (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety stops and lower until knees are near 90 degrees.
Press through your heels without locking your knees.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Magnum Hack Squat (Matrix)
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad, shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot, then re-lock the safety.
tips: Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Magnum Kneeling Leg Curl (Matrix)
steps: Kneel on the pad and put one leg under the roller.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips still; do not twist to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Magnum Reclining Leg Extension (Matrix)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Magnum Standing Hip Abductor (Matrix)
steps: Stand beside the machine with the pad on your outer thigh.
Hold the handle and lift your leg out to the side.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright; do not lean away.

exercises.name: Magnum Standing Calf (Matrix)
steps: Stand with your shoulders under the pads and balls of feet on the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Keep your knees straight but not locked.

exercises.name: Magnum Seated Calf (Matrix)
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform, pads on lower thighs.
Release the lever and raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Re-engage the lever before stepping out.

exercises.name: Magnum Glute Trainer (Matrix)
steps: Sit with your upper back on the pad and the hip pad across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your ribs down; do not arch your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Magnum Pendulum Squat (Matrix)
steps: Step in with your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Release the lock and squat deep as the arm swings.
Drive back up, then lock the safety when finished.
tips: Go only as deep as you can keep your hips on the pad.

exercises.name: Magnum Belt Squat (Matrix)
steps: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Release the lever and squat down with an upright torso.
Stand up by driving through your feet, then re-lock.
tips: The spine is unloaded, but keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Magnum Standing Hip Thrust (Matrix)
steps: Step in and set the hip pad against your hips.
Hinge back at the hips, then drive them forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and return slowly.
tips: Finish with the glutes, not by leaning your upper body back.

exercises.name: Magnum Breaker Olympic Flat Bench (Matrix)
steps: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat.
Unrack and lower the bar under control to mid chest.
Press up, then return the bar to the hooks.
tips: Use a spotter for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Magnum Breaker Olympic Incline Bench (Matrix)
steps: Sit back on the incline with your eyes under the bar and feet flat.
Unrack and lower the bar under control to your upper chest.
Press up, then return the bar to the hooks.
tips: Use a spotter for heavy sets.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Row (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid chest, chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not jerk with your lower back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cybex)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down to upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Do not lean far back or swing the weight.

exercises.name: Arm Curl (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Arm Extension (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot on the pad.
Straighten your elbows to push the handles away.
Return slowly without lifting your elbows.
tips: Only the forearms move; keep the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Abdominal (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat, secure your feet and hold the handles or pads.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch forward.
Return slowly without letting the stack rest.
tips: Move from your spine; do not pull with your arms.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat and place the roller pad across your upper back.
Push back by extending your spine and hips.
Return slowly to the start position.
tips: Move smoothly and do not snap back at the top.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation (Cybex)
steps: Set the start position and sit with your knees against the pads.
Hold the handles and rotate your torso to one side.
Return slowly, then reset the machine for the other side.
tips: Rotate slowly; never swing into the end range.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Cybex)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees.
Place your feet shoulder-width on the plate and press away.
Stop short of locking your knees, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Cybex)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Cybex)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Lock the thigh pad down and place the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels under the seat, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your hips down against the seat.

exercises.name: Prone Leg Curl (Cybex)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad edge.
Place the roller above your heels and curl toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.

exercises.name: Eagle NX Calf (Cybex)
steps: Sit and place the balls of your feet on the curved footplate.
With knees almost straight, push through your toes.
Let your heels come back slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Use the full range; pause briefly in the stretch.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Standing Calf (Cybex)
steps: Stand with your shoulders under the pads and balls of feet on the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Keep your knees straight but not locked.

exercises.name: Glute (Cybex)
steps: Set the abdominal pad, lean on it and hold the handles.
Place one foot on the footbar and push back by extending your hip.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your lower back neutral; drive with the glute, not the spine.

exercises.name: Eagle NX Hip Abduction/Adduction (Cybex)
steps: Set the pads for inner-thigh or outer-thigh mode.
Squeeze your legs in, or push them out, depending on the mode.
Return slowly and under control to the start.
tips: Switch modes only with the weight fully lowered.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Hip Abduction (Cybex)
steps: Sit with your outer thighs against the pads.
Push your knees outward as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly without letting the weights touch.
tips: Sit tall and do not rock your torso.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Hip Adduction (Cybex)
steps: Sit with your legs on the pads at a comfortable wide start.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the stretched start.
tips: Pick a start width you can control, not your maximum split.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Fly/Rear Delt (Cybex)
steps: Set the arm start position for chest fly or for rear delt.
For fly, bring the handles together; for rear delt, face the pad and sweep back.
Control the return and keep a slight bend in the elbows.
tips: Change the arm setting before switching exercises, never mid set.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Lateral Raise (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Place your arms on the pads and raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
tips: Lead with the elbows and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Dip/Chin Assist (Cybex)
steps: Choose the assist weight; more weight gives you more help.
Kneel on the pad and do a pull-up or a dip.
Lower yourself slowly and under control.
tips: Step off the pad only when it is fully down.

exercises.name: Prestige VRS Triceps Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit beside your hips at the start.
Sit tall and push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Chest Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Load both sides evenly before you sit down.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Overhead Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Leg Press (Cybex)
steps: Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety stops and lower until knees are near 90 degrees.
Press through your heels without locking your knees.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Squat Press (Cybex)
steps: Step in with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot, then re-lock the safety.
tips: Keep your hips and back in contact with the pad.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Hack Squat (Cybex)
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad, shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot, then re-lock the safety.
tips: Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Seated Calf (Cybex)
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform, pads on lower thighs.
Release the lever and raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Re-engage the lever before stepping out.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Smith Press (Cybex)
steps: Set the bar height and the safety stops for your exercise.
Rotate the bar to unrack it, then squat or press.
Rotate the bar back onto the hooks to finish.
tips: Always set the safety stops just below your lowest point.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (gym80)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (gym80)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad edge.
Place the roller above your heels and curl toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (gym80)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Lock the thigh pad down and place the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels under the seat, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your hips down against the seat.

exercises.name: Lower Back Machine (gym80)
steps: Set the seat and place the roller pad across your upper back.
Push back by extending your spine and hips.
Return slowly to the start position.
tips: Move smoothly and do not snap back at the top.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch (gym80)
steps: Set the seat, secure your feet and hold the handles or pads.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch forward.
Return slowly without letting the stack rest.
tips: Move from your spine; do not pull with your arms.

exercises.name: Biceps Machine (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot on the pad.
Straighten your elbows to push the handles away.
Return slowly without lifting your elbows.
tips: Only the forearms move; keep the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Pull Over Machine (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot and fasten the belt.
Place your elbows on the pads and drive them down toward your hips.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead with a stretch.
tips: Push with the elbows, not the hands.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Press (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press the handles up and forward with your back on the pad.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown Machine (gym80)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down to upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Do not lean far back or swing the weight.

exercises.name: Butterfly (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the arms of the machine sit at chest height.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of you.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.
tips: Do not let your arms travel behind your body at the stretch.

exercises.name: Butterfly Reverse (gym80)
steps: Sit facing the pad and set the seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Hold the handles with nearly straight arms and sweep them back.
Squeeze your upper back, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad and do not shrug.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid chest, chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not jerk with your lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Press (gym80)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees.
Place your feet shoulder-width on the plate and press away.
Stop short of locking your knees, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Abduction Machine (gym80)
steps: Sit with your outer thighs against the pads.
Push your knees outward as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly without letting the weights touch.
tips: Sit tall and do not rock your torso.

exercises.name: Adduction Machine (gym80)
steps: Sit with your legs on the pads at a comfortable wide start.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the stretched start.
tips: Pick a start width you can control, not your maximum split.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise Machine (gym80)
steps: Stand with your shoulders under the pads and balls of feet on the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Keep your knees straight but not locked.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft T-Bar Row (gym80)
steps: Stand on the foot platform, hinge forward and grip the handles.
Keep a flat back and row the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep a neutral spine; never round your lower back.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft 45 Degrees Linear Leg Press (gym80)
steps: Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety stops and lower until knees are near 90 degrees.
Press through your heels without locking your knees.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Hack Squat (gym80)
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad, shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety and squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot, then re-lock the safety.
tips: Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Pendulum Squat (gym80)
steps: Step in with your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Release the lock and squat deep as the arm swings.
Drive back up, then lock the safety when finished.
tips: Go only as deep as you can keep your hips on the pad.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Belt Squat (gym80)
steps: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Release the lever and squat down with an upright torso.
Stand up by driving through your feet, then re-lock.
tips: The spine is unloaded, but keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Lat Pulldown Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down toward your upper chest.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Drive with the elbows, not the hands.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Low Row Dual (gym80)
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab the low handles.
Row the handles back toward your hips.
Squeeze your back, then let your arms extend slowly.
tips: Pull toward the hips to bias the lower lats.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft High Row Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so you reach the handles with arms up and forward.
Pull the handles down and back toward your sides.
Squeeze your back, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Seated Chest Press Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Load both sides evenly before you sit down.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Incline Chest Press Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press the handles up and forward with your back on the pad.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Shoulder Press Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Butterfly Dual (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so the arms of the machine sit at chest height.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of you.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.
tips: Do not let your arms travel behind your body at the stretch.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Seated Calf Raise (gym80)
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform, pads on lower thighs.
Release the lever and raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a full stretch.
tips: Re-engage the lever before stepping out.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Booty Booster (gym80)
steps: Rest your upper back on the pad and set the pelvic roller over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your ribs down; do not arch your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Leg Extension (gym80)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Lying Leg Curl (gym80)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad edge.
Place the roller above your heels and curl toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Biceps Curl (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Pure Kraft Pullover (gym80)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot and fasten the belt.
Place your elbows on the pads and drive them down toward your hips.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead with a stretch.
tips: Push with the elbows, not the hands.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles, keep your back on the pad and press forward.
Stop just short of locking your elbows, then return slowly.
tips: Pick the strength-curve setting before you sit down.

exercises.name: Incline Press (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press the handles up and forward with your back on the pad.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge.

exercises.name: Pec Fly (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so the arms of the machine sit at chest height.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of you.
Squeeze the chest, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.
tips: Do not let your arms travel behind your body at the stretch.

exercises.name: Pec/Rear Delt (Prime)
steps: Set the arm start position for chest fly or for rear delt.
For fly, bring the handles together; for rear delt, face the pad and sweep back.
Control the return and keep a slight bend in the elbows.
tips: Change the arm setting before switching exercises, never mid set.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Brace your back on the pad and press the handles overhead.
Stop short of lockout, then lower slowly to shoulder level.
tips: Do not arch your lower back off the pad.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Place your arms on the pads and raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
tips: Lead with the elbows and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Prime)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and sit tall.
Grip the handles and pull down to upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let your arms rise slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Do not lean far back or swing the weight.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid chest, chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward you, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then extend your arms slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not jerk with your lower back.

exercises.name: Pullover (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot and fasten the belt.
Place your elbows on the pads and drive them down toward your hips.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead with a stretch.
tips: Push with the elbows, not the hands.

exercises.name: Arm Curl (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up without lifting your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms pinned to the pad.

exercises.name: Tricep Extension (Prime)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot on the pad.
Straighten your elbows to push the handles away.
Return slowly without lifting your elbows.
tips: Only the forearms move; keep the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Seated Pushdown (Prime)
steps: Set the seat and lock the thigh pad down, handles beside your hips.
Sit tall and push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down, away from your ears.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch (Prime)
steps: Set the seat, secure your feet and hold the handles or pads.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch forward.
Return slowly without letting the stack rest.
tips: Move from your spine; do not pull with your arms.

exercises.name: Low Back Extension (Prime)
steps: Set the seat and place the roller pad across your upper back.
Push back by extending your spine and hips.
Return slowly to the start position.
tips: Move smoothly and do not snap back at the top.

exercises.name: Rotary Torso (Prime)
steps: Set the start range and sit with your thighs against the pads.
Hold the handles and rotate your torso to one side.
Return slowly, then reset the machine for the other side.
tips: Rotate slowly; never swing into the end range.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Prime)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees.
Place your feet shoulder-width on the plate and press away.
Stop short of locking your knees, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Prime)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Place the shin pad just above your ankles and straighten your legs.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Prime)
steps: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Lock the thigh pad down and place the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels under the seat, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your hips down against the seat.

exercises.name: Prone Leg Curl (Prime)
steps: Lie face down with your knees just off the pad edge.
Place the roller above your heels and curl toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without letting your hips rise.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Press (Prime)
steps: Sit and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
With knees almost straight, push through your toes.
Let your heels come back slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Use the full range; pause briefly in the stretch.

exercises.name: Multi-Hip (Prime)
steps: Stand on the platform and set the roller for the movement you want.
Move your leg forward, back, in or out against the pad.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your standing leg and torso still.

exercises.name: Inner Thigh (Prime)
steps: Sit with your legs on the pads at a comfortable wide start.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the stretched start.
tips: Pick a start width you can control, not your maximum split.

exercises.name: Outer Thigh (Prime)
steps: Sit with your outer thighs against the pads.
Push your knees outward as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly without letting the weights touch.
tips: Sit tall and do not rock your torso.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Keep your back on the pad and press the handles forward until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel a light stretch across the chest.
tips: Keep shoulder blades pulled back and avoid snapping your elbows into lockout.

exercises.name: Leverage Chest Press (Nautilus)
steps: Load equal plates on both sides and set the seat so handles reach mid-chest.
Press the handles forward on the converging path until arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly until hands are just in front of your chest.
tips: Load and unload plates evenly so the machine never tips to one side.

exercises.name: Incline Press (Nautilus)
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles start level with your upper chest.
Press up and forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to the start with elbows slightly below the handles.
tips: Keep your lower back against the pad instead of arching to push more weight.

exercises.name: Leverage Incline Press (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles sit at upper-chest height.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower under control until you feel a stretch in the upper chest.
tips: Keep your feet flat and your back on the pad through every rep.

exercises.name: Leverage Decline Press (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles line up with your lower chest.
Press the handles forward and slightly down until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until hands are just in front of your lower chest.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and back so the chest, not the shoulders, does the work.

exercises.name: Pec Fly / Rear Deltoid (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height and set the arms for fly or rear delt.
For chest, sit facing out and bring the handles together in front with a slight elbow bend.
For rear delts, face the pad and pull the handles back and out, then return slowly.
tips: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows and do not let the handles yank your shoulders back.
exercises.line: Inspiration (Pec Fly/Rear Deltoid), Instinct (Dual Pectoral Fly/Rear Deltoid), Impact (Deltoid Fly), Nitro Plus (Pec Fly/Rear Delt)

exercises.name: Lat Pull Down (Nautilus)
steps: Set the thigh pad so your legs are locked in snugly.
Grip the handles and pull down toward your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead.
tips: Lead with the elbows and avoid leaning far back or yanking with momentum.
exercises.line: Impact (Lat Pull Down, Fixed Lat Pull Down), Inspiration, Instinct (Lat Pull Down, Dual Lat Pull Down/Vertical Row), Nautilus One

exercises.name: Leverage Lat Pull Down (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit down, and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull the handles down and slightly back until elbows reach your sides.
Return slowly to a full stretch overhead.
tips: Keep your chest up and stop the rep before your shoulders roll forward.

exercises.name: Vertical Row (Nautilus)
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you reach the handles with arms straight.
Keep your chest on the pad and pull the handles back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
tips: Keep your chest glued to the pad; do not rock your torso to move the weight.
exercises.line: Impact, Inspiration, Instinct (Vertical Row, Dual Lat Pull Down/Vertical Row), Nitro (Compound Row)

exercises.name: Impact Low Row (Nautilus)
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and feet firmly planted.
Pull the low handles toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
tips: Keep your spine tall and let your shoulder blades move, not your lower back.

exercises.name: Leverage High Row (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit, and secure your thighs under the pad.
Pull the high handles down and back toward your chest.
Let the handles return slowly up and forward to a full stretch.
tips: Pull with your elbows and keep your chest tall rather than rounding forward.

exercises.name: Leverage Low Row (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly and sit with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles back to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad so your lower back stays neutral.

exercises.name: Leverage Incline Lever Row (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, stand on the foot platform, and lie your chest on the angled pad.
Grip the handles and row them toward your torso, driving elbows back.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad the whole set to protect your lower back.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your back against the pad and avoid flaring your ribs to lift more.

exercises.name: Leverage Shoulder Press (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Press the handles up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower under control to the starting position.
tips: Brace your core and keep your head neutral against the pad.

exercises.name: Instinct Dual Multi-Press (Nautilus)
steps: Choose the chest, incline or shoulder position by adjusting the seat and back pad.
Press the handles away until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly to the start without letting the stack touch down.
tips: Re-check the seat height each time you switch between press positions.

exercises.name: Deltoid Raise (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot points.
Place your arms against the pads and raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your sides.
tips: Lead with the elbows and do not shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.

exercises.name: Pullover (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders align with the pivot and fasten the belt if fitted.
Place your elbows on the pads and drive them forward and down toward your hips.
Let your arms return slowly overhead to a comfortable stretch.
tips: Push with your elbows, not your hands, and stop the stretch before shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl (Nautilus)
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Grip the handles and curl up until your biceps are fully squeezed.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad and do not lean back to swing the weight.
exercises.line: Impact, Inspiration (Biceps Curl, Bilateral Arm Curl), Instinct (Dual Biceps Curl/Triceps Extension), Nautilus One

exercises.name: Leverage Biceps Curl (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so your elbows sit on the pad by the pivot.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.
tips: Use a full but controlled range; do not let the arm drop fast at the bottom.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Nautilus)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Push the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your forearms pass just beyond 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your elbows planted on the pad so only your forearms move.
exercises.line: Impact, Inspiration, Instinct (Dual Biceps Curl/Triceps Extension)

exercises.name: Tricep Dip (Nautilus)
steps: Sit tall, fasten the belt if fitted, and grip the handles beside your hips.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let them rise slowly until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and back, not hunched toward your ears.
exercises.line: Inspiration (Tricep Dip), Impact (Dip Machine), Nautilus One (Triceps Press)

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Tricep Dip (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit down, and grip the dip handles at your sides.
Press down until your arms are fully straight.
Return slowly until your elbows bend to about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your torso upright to keep the load on the triceps.

exercises.name: Chin Dip Assist (Nautilus)
steps: Select the assist weight; more weight gives you more help.
Kneel on the pad and pull your chin over the bar, then lower slowly.
For dips, use the dip handles and lower until elbows reach about 90 degrees, then press up.
tips: Step on and off the knee pad carefully, one foot at a time, while holding the handles.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Nautilus)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend to about 90 degrees with feet flat on the platform.
Push through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Bend your knees slowly back to the start.
tips: Do not lock your knees or let your lower back lift off the seat.
exercises.line: Impact (Seated Leg Press), Inspiration, Instinct (Dual Leg Press/Calf Raise), Nautilus One, Nitro Plus

exercises.name: Angled Leg Press (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, sit back fully, and place feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking your knees, then re-engage the safeties.
tips: Stop lowering before your hips curl up off the back pad.
exercises.line: Leverage / Plate Loaded (Angled Leg Press, Angled Leg Press Pro)

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, step in with your back on the pad and shoulders under the pads.
Release the safeties and squat down until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your feet to standing, then lock the safeties.
tips: Keep your whole back on the pad and your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, step onto the platform, and set your shoulders under the pads.
Release the lock and sink down in the swinging arc as deep as you control.
Push through your feet to rise back to the top.
tips: Keep your hips and back against the pad; go only as deep as you can without your lower back rounding.

exercises.name: Leverage Power Squat (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, face toward or away from the unit, and set your feet on the wide platform.
Get into position on the lever and squat down until thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your mid-foot to stand tall.
tips: Keep your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, stand on the platform, and attach the belt around your hips.
Release the lever and squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet back to standing.
tips: The load sits on your hips, so keep your spine neutral and let your legs do the work.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Nautilus)
steps: Set the back pad so knees align with the pivot and the shin pad sits above your ankles.
Straighten your legs until your quads are fully squeezed.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
tips: Hold the side handles and keep your hips down on the seat.
exercises.line: Impact, Inspiration, Instinct (Leg Extension, Dual Leg Extension/Leg Curl), Nitro Plus

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Nautilus)
steps: Line your knees up with the pivot and lock the thigh pad down snugly.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Let your legs return slowly to almost straight.
tips: Keep the thigh pad tight so your hips stay pinned to the seat.
exercises.line: Impact (Seated Leg Curl), Inspiration (Leg Curl), Instinct (Leg Curl, Dual Leg Extension/Leg Curl)

exercises.name: Impact Leg Curl (Prone) (Nautilus)
steps: Lie face down with knees just off the pad edge and the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes while holding the handles.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad; do not lift them to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Impact Kneeling Leg Curl (Nautilus)
steps: Kneel on the pad with forearms on the support and one heel under the roller.
Curl that heel up toward your glutes.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips still and avoid twisting to lift the weight.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates and lie face down with the roller just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, holding the handles.
Lower slowly to nearly straight legs.
tips: Keep your hips flat on the pad throughout the set.

exercises.name: Hip Abductor (Nautilus)
steps: Sit back with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees outward as far as you comfortably can.
Bring them back together slowly without letting the stack slam.
tips: Keep your back against the pad and move only at the hips.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor (Nautilus)
steps: Sit back and set the start width so you feel a mild inner-thigh stretch.
Squeeze your knees together against the pads.
Open your legs slowly back to the start.
tips: Choose a start width you control; do not force a deep stretch.

exercises.name: Glute Press (Nautilus)
steps: Set the ramp, lean in on the pad, and hold the stabilisation bars.
Place one foot on the foot plate and push it back by extending your hip.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso still and your lower back neutral; do not arch to push further.

exercises.name: Glute Drive (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, sit on the seat, and set the hip pad across your hips with feet flat.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower with control without fully resting at the bottom.
tips: Tuck your chin and ribs down so your glutes, not your lower back, finish the lift.

exercises.name: Impact Standing Calf (Nautilus)
steps: Set the shoulder pads so you stand tall with the balls of your feet on the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step for a stretch.
tips: Keep your knees straight but not locked, and pause briefly at the top.

exercises.name: Standing Calf (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, step under the shoulder pads, and place the balls of your feet on the edge.
Push up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly until your heels drop below the platform.
tips: Use a full stretch and avoid bouncing out of the bottom.

exercises.name: Tilt Seat Calf (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, sit down, and set the pad snug above your knees with balls of feet on the platform.
Push up through your toes to lift the pad as high as possible.
Lower slowly until you feel a full calf stretch.
tips: Move only at the ankles and pause at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch (Nautilus)
steps: Adjust the seat and hook your feet or set the chest pad as the machine requires.
Curl your torso forward and down by tightening your abs.
Return slowly to upright without letting the stack rest.
tips: Breathe out as you crunch and do not pull with your arms or neck.
exercises.line: Impact (Abdominal), Inspiration (Abdominal Crunch), Instinct (Dual Abdominal/Lower Back)

exercises.name: Leverage Abdominal Crunch (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit, and grip the handles by your chest.
Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly to the start position.
tips: Start light; this machine loads heavily and should not strain your neck.

exercises.name: Low Back / Back Extension (Nautilus)
steps: Sit with the back pad across your upper back and fasten the belt if fitted.
Extend backward slowly until your body is upright or slightly past it.
Return forward under control.
tips: Use light weight and smooth reps; never jerk into the extension.
exercises.line: Impact (Low Back), Inspiration (Back Extension), Instinct (Dual Abdominal/Lower Back)

exercises.name: Rotary Torso (Nautilus)
steps: Set the start angle, sit, and lock your legs in the pads.
Rotate your torso to one side using your abs, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish the set, then switch the start side.
tips: Use a small, controlled range and light weight to protect your spine.

exercises.name: Leverage Deadlift Shrug (Nautilus)
steps: Load plates, step inside, and grip the handles with a flat back.
Stand up by driving your hips forward for the deadlift.
At the top, shrug your shoulders straight up, then lower everything slowly.
tips: Keep your back flat and do not roll your shoulders during the shrug.

exercises.name: Dual Adjustable Pulley (Nautilus)
steps: Set both pulleys to the height your exercise needs and pick the weight.
Clip on a handle or bar and step into a stable stance.
Perform the movement slowly, controlling the cable on the way back.
tips: Keep the stacks from touching down between reps to keep tension on the muscle.

exercises.name: Smith Machine (Nautilus)
steps: Set the safety stops just below your lowest point, then load the bar.
Unhook the bar by rotating it and perform squats, presses or lunges on the fixed track.
Rotate the bar to re-hook it on the nearest hooks when finished.
tips: Always set the safety stops before loading heavy weight.

exercises.name: Instinct 45° Back Extension (Nautilus)
steps: Set the hip pad just below your hip bones and hook your heels under the rollers.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Raise back up until your body forms a straight line.
tips: Stop at a straight line; do not hyperextend your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Instinct Adjustable Abdominal Decline Bench (Nautilus)
steps: Set the decline angle and hook your feet under the rollers.
Curl your torso up by tightening your abs.
Lower slowly back toward the bench without fully relaxing.
tips: Start with a lower angle and keep your chin off your chest.
exercises.line: Instinct (Adjustable Abdominal Decline Bench, Ab Bench)

exercises.name: Instinct Olympic Flat Bench (Nautilus)
steps: Lie with eyes under the bar and feet flat, then grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack and lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up over your shoulders and re-rack.
tips: Use a spotter or safety for heavy sets and keep your shoulder blades pinned.

exercises.name: Instinct Olympic Incline Bench (Nautilus)
steps: Sit with your back flat on the incline and feet planted, grip just wider than shoulders.
Unrack and lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press it back up and re-rack with control.
tips: Keep your hips on the seat; do not bridge to turn it into a flat press.

exercises.name: Nautilus One Four-Way Neck
steps: Adjust the seat so the head pad meets your forehead, back or side of head.
Move your head slowly against the pad through a short, pain-free range.
Return slowly, then turn the seat for the next direction.
tips: Use very light weight and slow reps; the neck should never be jerked.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades back and your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Insignia Series Dual Axis Chest Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Press forward and let the handles travel inward on your own converging path.
Return slowly and wide to a chest stretch.
tips: Let the handles move naturally; do not force a fixed straight line.

exercises.name: Axiom Series Multi-Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the back pad and seat for chest, incline or shoulder pressing.
Press the handles away until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to the start position.
tips: Re-set the seat height each time you switch press angles.

exercises.name: Pectoral Fly / Rear Deltoid (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit at shoulder height and set the arm start position.
For chest, bring the handles together in front of you with a slight elbow bend.
For rear delts, face the pad and pull the handles back and out, then return slowly.
tips: Keep a fixed soft bend in the elbows and do not overstretch at the start.

exercises.name: Pulldown (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the thigh pad so your legs are held firmly.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Let them rise slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid leaning far back to finish the rep.
exercises.line: Insignia (Pulldown), Signature (Pull Down), Axiom (Lat Pulldown, Lat Pulldown/Low Row), Optima (Lat Pulldown/Low Row), Circuit (Lat Pulldown)

exercises.name: Insignia Series Dual Axis Pulldown (Life Fitness)
steps: Lock your thighs under the pad and grip the handles overhead.
Pull down and let the handles follow your natural path toward your sides.
Return slowly to a full overhead stretch.
tips: Pull with the elbows and keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you reach the handles with arms straight.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad and avoid rocking your torso.
exercises.line: Insignia (Row), Signature (Row/Rear Deltoid), Optima (Seated Row), Circuit (Seated Row), Axiom (Seated Row)

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height.
Press overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and do not arch your lower back.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot points.
Press your arms into the pads and raise elbows to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to your sides.
tips: Do not shrug; keep your shoulders down while lifting.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the pivot.
Curl the handles up until your biceps are fully squeezed.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad and avoid swinging your body.
exercises.line: Insignia (Biceps Curl, Biceps Curl - Dependent), Signature, Optima (Biceps Curl, Biceps/Triceps), Axiom (Biceps Curl, Biceps/Triceps), Circuit

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows sit on the pad in line with the pivot.
Push the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your forearms are just past 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your elbows fixed on the pad so only the forearms move.
exercises.line: Insignia, Optima (Triceps Extension, Biceps/Triceps), Axiom (Triceps Extension, Biceps/Triceps)

exercises.name: Triceps Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Sit tall and grip the dip-style handles at your sides.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let them rise slowly until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and your chest up through each rep.

exercises.name: Insignia Series Assist Dip Chin (Life Fitness)
steps: Select the assist weight; more weight gives more help.
Kneel on the pad and pull your chin over the bar, then lower slowly.
For dips, hold the dip handles, lower to about 90 degrees, and press up.
tips: Hold the handles while stepping on and off the knee pad.

exercises.name: Abdominal (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles or set the chest pad.
Crunch forward by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly to upright.
tips: Breathe out as you crunch and do not pull with your arms.
exercises.line: Insignia (Abdominal, Abdominal Advanced), Signature, Optima, Axiom (Abdominal, Abdominal/Back Extension), Circuit (Ab Crunch)

exercises.name: Back Extension (Life Fitness)
steps: Sit with the back pad across your upper back and feet set on the platform.
Extend backward slowly until upright or slightly past.
Return forward with control.
tips: Keep the motion smooth and the weight light; never jerk.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the start position, sit, and secure your legs.
Rotate your torso to one side using your core.
Return slowly, finish the set, then switch sides.
tips: Use a controlled range and light weight to protect your spine.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees with feet flat on the platform.
Push through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Bend your knees slowly back to the start.
tips: Do not lock your knees or let your hips lift off the seat.
exercises.line: Insignia (Arc Leg Press), Signature (Seated Leg Press), Optima, Axiom, Circuit (Squat)

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the back pad so knees align with the pivot and the shin pad sits above your ankles.
Straighten your legs until your quads are fully squeezed.
Lower slowly to about 90 degrees of knee bend.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your hips down on the seat.
exercises.line: Insignia, Signature (Seated Leg Extension), Optima, Circuit, Axiom (Leg Extension, Leg Extension/Leg Curl, Seated Leg Curl/Extension)

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Life Fitness)
steps: Line your knees up with the pivot and lock the thigh pad down.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.
tips: Keep the thigh pad snug so your hips stay on the seat.
exercises.line: Insignia, Signature, Axiom (Seated Leg Curl/Extension), Circuit (Leg Curl)

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Prone) (Life Fitness)
steps: Lie face down with knees just past the pad and the roller above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes while holding the handles.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the pad throughout.
exercises.line: Insignia (Leg Curl), Optima (Leg Curl), Axiom (Leg Curl, Leg Extension/Leg Curl)

exercises.name: Calf Extension (Life Fitness)
steps: Adjust the seat so the balls of your feet rest on the platform edge, knees slightly bent.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes as far as you can.
Let your heels return slowly for a full calf stretch.
tips: Move only at the ankles; keep your knees still.

exercises.name: Glute (Life Fitness)
steps: Lean on the chest pad, hold the handles, and place the working leg's thigh against the lever pad.
Push the leg back by extending your hip until it is in line with your body.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Do not arch your lower back to push further; stop at hip extension.

exercises.name: Insignia Series Glute Bridge (Life Fitness)
steps: Sit back against the pad and set the hip pad across your hips with feet flat.
Drive your hips up until they are in line with your shoulders and knees.
Lower slowly without fully resting.
tips: Keep ribs down and squeeze your glutes at the top instead of arching your back.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Life Fitness)
steps: Sit back with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees outward as far as comfortable.
Bring them back together slowly.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and do not let the stack slam.
exercises.line: Insignia (Hip Abduction / Adduction, Sit / Stand Hip Abductor), Signature (Hip Abduction), Optima (Hip Abductor/Adductor), Axiom (Hip Abductor Adductor)

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Life Fitness)
steps: Sit back and set a start width with a mild inner-thigh stretch.
Squeeze your knees together against the pads.
Open your legs slowly back to the start.
tips: Pick a start width you control; do not force the stretch.
exercises.line: Insignia (Hip Adduction, Hip Abduction / Adduction), Signature (Hip Adduction), Optima (Hip Abductor/Adductor), Axiom (Hip Abductor Adductor)

exercises.name: Dual Adjustable Pulley (Life Fitness)
steps: Set both pulleys to the height your exercise needs and pick the weight.
Attach a handle or bar and take a stable stance.
Move slowly and control the cable on the way back.
tips: Keep tension on the cable between reps by not letting the stack touch down.

exercises.name: Smith Machine (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the safety stops just below your lowest point, then load the bar.
Rotate the bar off the hooks and squat, press or lunge on the fixed track.
Rotate the bar to re-hook it when you finish.
tips: Always set the safety stops before heavy sets.

exercises.name: Dip/Leg Raise (Life Fitness)
steps: Place forearms on the pads, back against the backrest, and let legs hang.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling the pelvis up slightly.
Lower slowly; for dips, use the handles and lower to about 90 degrees.
tips: Avoid swinging; control the legs on the way down.

exercises.name: Abdominal Bench (Life Fitness)
steps: Set the angle and hook your feet under the rollers.
Curl your torso up by tightening your abs.
Lower slowly toward the bench without fully relaxing.
tips: Keep your chin off your chest and do not yank on your neck.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Calf Raise (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates, sit, and set the thigh pad snug above your knees with balls of feet on the platform.
Push up through your toes to raise the pad as high as possible.
Lower slowly until your heels are below the platform.
tips: Pause at the top and avoid bouncing at the bottom.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Decline Chest Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles line up with your lower chest.
Press forward and slightly down until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly to the start.
tips: Keep your back on the pad and shoulders down.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Incline Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so handles sit at upper-chest height.
Press up and forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly to a stretch in the upper chest.
tips: Keep your hips and back on the pad through the press.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Seated Dip (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit, and grip the handles at your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
tips: Stay upright to keep the work on the triceps.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Pulldown (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit, and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull the handles down until your elbows reach your sides.
Return slowly to a full overhead stretch.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid jerking the weight down.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded High Row (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly, sit, and secure your thighs under the pad.
Pull the handles down and back toward your chest.
Return slowly up and forward.
tips: Drive with the elbows and keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Row (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly and sit with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly to the start.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad so your lower back stays neutral.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Shoulder Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Press overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
tips: Brace your core and keep your back on the pad.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Kneeling Leg Curl (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates, kneel on the pad, and set one heel under the roller.
Curl that heel up toward your glutes.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square and still during each rep.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Leg Extension (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates and set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Straighten your legs until your quads are fully squeezed.
Lower slowly to about 90 degrees.
tips: Hold the handles and keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Linear Leg Press (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates, sit back fully, and place feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking your knees, then re-engage the safeties.
tips: Stop lowering before your hips roll off the back pad.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Biceps Curl (Life Fitness)
steps: Load plates evenly and set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad by the pivot.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.
tips: Keep your upper arms on the pad and avoid dropping the weight.

exercises.name: Super Lower Chest Flight (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit just below chest height.
Grip the handles with a slight elbow bend and brace your back on the pad.
Sweep the arms down and together, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the elbow angle fixed; do not turn the fly into a press.

exercises.name: Super Middle Chest Flight (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Grip the handles with soft elbows and keep your chest up.
Bring the arms together in a wide arc, squeeze, then open under control.
tips: Stop the stretch where your shoulders still feel stable.

exercises.name: Super Upper Chest Flight (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start around shoulder level.
Grip with soft elbows and keep shoulder blades back.
Sweep the arms up and together, squeeze, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not shrug; keep the shoulders down away from the ears.

exercises.name: Super Horizontal Bench Press (Panatta)
steps: Lie on the bench with the handles in line with mid chest.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up to near lockout, then lower slowly to a deep stretch.
tips: Keep your hips and upper back on the pad the whole set.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP (Horizontal Bench Press)

exercises.name: Super Inclined Bench Press (Panatta)
steps: Lie back on the incline pad with handles in line with upper chest.
Grip the handles and set your shoulder blades back and down.
Press up and slightly in, then lower under control.
tips: Do not let the elbows flare straight out to the sides.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP

exercises.name: Super Inclined Chest Press (Panatta)
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles start at upper chest height.
Sit tall with your back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press up and forward, then return slowly to a full stretch.
tips: Keep your head and back against the pad; do not arch hard.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP

exercises.name: Super Vertical Chest Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid chest.
Sit with your back on the pad and feet flat.
Press forward to near lockout, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the shoulders pinned back; do not round forward at the end.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP

exercises.name: Super Declined Chest Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start near lower chest.
Sit tall with your back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press down and forward, then return slowly.
tips: Use a full but pain-free range; stop if the shoulder front pinches.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP

exercises.name: Super Horizontal Multi Press (Panatta)
steps: Lie on the bench and choose a grip width on the multi-grip bars.
Unrack and set your shoulder blades back with feet planted.
Lower to your chest under control, then press back up.
tips: A narrower grip shifts more work to the triceps.

exercises.name: Power Smith Machine Dual System (Panatta)
steps: Set the bench angle (flat or decline) and lie under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders and unhook the bar.
Lower to the chest, press up, then rehook at the top.
tips: Set the safety stops just below your chest before the first rep.

exercises.name: Olympic Smith Machine Counterbalanced (Panatta)
steps: Set the bar at upper chest height and the safety stops below.
Step under the bar, rest it on your upper back and unhook it.
Squat to a good depth, drive up, then rehook the bar.
tips: Set the safeties first; the guided bar can still trap you.

exercises.name: Dips Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start around lower chest level.
Choose a handle width and sit tall against the pad.
Press down until your arms are straight, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the elbows close to the body to load the triceps.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special (also Dips Press Dual System); Fit Evo (selectorized)

exercises.name: Super Pullover Machine (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivot.
Place elbows on the pads and let the arms travel back to a stretch.
Drive the elbows down in an arc to your sides, then return slowly.
tips: Push with the elbows, not the hands, to keep the lats working.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Fit Evo (Pullover machine)

exercises.name: Pectoral Machine (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height and pick the weight.
Grip the handles with a slight elbow bend, back on the pad.
Bring the arms together, squeeze, then open slowly.
tips: Use the pre-load lever to start safely from the stretch.

exercises.name: Super Peck Back (Panatta)
steps: Face the chest pad and set the seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Grip the handles with straight but soft arms.
Pull the arms back and out wide, pause, then return slowly.
tips: Facing the other way turns it into a chest fly; keep the setup right.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Fit Evo (Peck back, selectorized)

exercises.name: Back Deltoids (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles sit at shoulder height.
Rest your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Open the arms back in a wide arc, pause, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the chest on the pad; do not lean back to swing the weight.

exercises.name: Vertical Chest Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so handles line up with mid chest and pick the weight.
Sit with your back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press forward to near lockout, then return slowly.
tips: Use the pre-load lever to bring the handles in safely.

exercises.name: Vertical Chest Press Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so handles are at mid chest and select the load.
Sit tall with your back on the pad.
Press the handles forward in their arc, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the wrists straight and stacked over the elbows.

exercises.name: Inclined Chest Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start at upper chest and pick the weight.
Sit back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press up and in, then lower slowly to a stretch.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad; do not bridge up.

exercises.name: Inclined Chest Press Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat height and select the weight.
Sit back on the pad and grip the handles at upper chest.
Press up through the arc, then return slowly.
tips: Control the lowering phase for two to three seconds.

exercises.name: Total Press (Panatta)
steps: Choose the press angle: decline, flat, incline or overhead.
Set the seat and select the weight, then grip the handles.
Press out to near lockout, then return slowly.
tips: Pick one angle per set and keep the shoulders stable.

exercises.name: Standing Multi Flight (Panatta)
steps: Set the lever start angle for the move you want and select the weight.
Stand facing the right way and grip the handles.
Raise the arms in a smooth arc to shoulder height, then lower slowly.
tips: Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Super Deltoid Press (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles start just above shoulder height.
Sit with your back on the pad and grip pronated or neutral.
Press overhead to near lockout, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your ribs down; do not arch the lower back to finish.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Panatta)
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at shoulder level.
Sit back on the pad and grip the handles.
Press up overhead, then lower to shoulder height slowly.
tips: Brace your core and keep your head against the pad.

exercises.name: Deltoid Press Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so handles start at shoulder level and pick the weight.
Sit tall with your back on the pad.
Press overhead through the arc, then lower slowly.
tips: Use the pre-load lever to start without straining the shoulders.

exercises.name: Lateral Deltoids (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivots.
Place arms against the pads and grip the handles.
Raise the elbows out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not shrug; let the delts lift, not the traps.
exercises.line: Fit Evo; Monolith; Free Weight Special (plate-loaded)

exercises.name: Viking Press and Calf (Panatta)
steps: Stand on the platform under the handles and pick a grip.
Brace your core and press the handles overhead.
Lower to shoulder level under control and repeat.
tips: For calf raises, use the shoulder supports and a full ankle range.

exercises.name: Super Shrug Machine (Panatta)
steps: Stand between the handles and grip them with straight arms.
Stand tall and lift the load off the start position.
Shrug the shoulders straight up, pause, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not roll the shoulders; lift straight up and down.

exercises.name: Super Lat Pulldown Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and grip the neutral handles overhead.
Lift your chest and pull the shoulders down first.
Pull the elbows down to your sides, then let the arms rise slowly.
tips: Do not lean far back; keep the pull vertical.

exercises.name: Lat Machine Convergent (Panatta)
steps: Sit with thighs under the pad and pick a grip on the angled bars.
Brace with chest up and shoulders down.
Pull the handles down to upper chest, then return slowly.
tips: Let the arms fully extend at the top for a full lat stretch.
exercises.line: Free Weight HP; Free Weight Special (Super Lat Machine Convergent)

exercises.name: Super Dorsy Bar (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat and thigh pad so you are locked in.
Grip the bar and lift your chest.
Pull the bar down toward your chest, then return slowly.
tips: Drive the elbows down, not back, to keep tension on the lats.

exercises.name: Front Dorsy Bar (Panatta)
steps: Set your position and choose pronated, semi-pronated or neutral handles.
Brace with chest up and feet set.
Pull the handles down and in, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your torso still; do not swing to move the load.

exercises.name: Super Low Row (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat and chest pad so you reach the handles with straight arms.
Grip the neutral handles with your chest on the pad.
Row the elbows back past your torso, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad; do not jerk with the lower back.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP (Low Row / Super Low Row)

exercises.name: High Row (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are above and in front of you.
Grip the handles and lock your thighs under the pad.
Pull down and back toward your lower chest, then return slowly.
tips: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end of each rep.
exercises.line: Free Weight HP; Free Weight Special (Super High Row)

exercises.name: Super Power Row (Panatta)
steps: Set the chest pad so your arms reach the handles fully extended.
Grip the handles with chest firmly on the pad.
Row straight back, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: For one-arm sets, hold the fixed center handle for stability.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP (Power Row)

exercises.name: Super Rowing (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat and chest pad, then pick a grip position.
Brace your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull the elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
tips: A wide grip hits upper back; a neutral grip hits more lats.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP (Rowing machine)

exercises.name: Super Rowing Circular (Panatta)
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad to reach the handles.
Grip the handles with your chest on the pad.
Row back through the arc, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the neck neutral and the chest still.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row (Panatta)
steps: Set the chest pad height and step onto the platform.
Lie on the chest pad and grip the handles.
Row up toward your chest, squeeze, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your chest on the pad to protect the lower back.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Panatta)
steps: Set the thigh pad snug and select the weight.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulders and lift your chest.
Pull the bar to upper chest, then let it rise slowly.
tips: Do not pull behind the neck.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat and thigh rolls, then select the weight.
Grip the handles overhead with chest up.
Pull the elbows down to your sides, then return slowly.
tips: Try one arm at a time to fix side-to-side imbalances.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine Circular (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat and chest pad, then select the weight.
Grip the handles with your chest on the pad.
Row back, squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
tips: Avoid shrugging as you pull.

exercises.name: Pulley Row (Panatta)
steps: Sit with feet on the footrest and knees slightly bent.
Grip the handle with arms straight and chest up.
Row the handle to your stomach, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the torso upright; do not rock back and forth.

exercises.name: Total Back (Panatta)
steps: Choose the pull angle: low row, power row, high row or pulldown.
Set the seat, select the weight and grip the handles.
Pull the elbows back or down, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep one angle per set so you can track progress.

exercises.name: High Row Convergent (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so the handles are above and ahead of you.
Select the weight and grip the handles.
Pull down and back to the chest, then return slowly.
tips: Pull with the elbows and keep the wrists relaxed.

exercises.name: Lower Back (Panatta)
steps: Sit with the back pad across your upper back and feet set.
Select a light weight and cross your arms.
Extend back slowly to upright, then return forward under control.
tips: Move slowly and never jerk; start light.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension (Panatta)
steps: Lie face down with hips at the pad edge and hold the handles.
Hook your ankles under the roller.
Raise the legs to hip level with your glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not swing; lift no higher than a straight line with your body.

exercises.name: Jammer (Panatta)
steps: Stand facing the arms with feet hip-width and grip the handles at shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees and brace your core.
Drive up and out with legs and arms, then return under control.
tips: Keep the core tight so the lower back does not arch.

exercises.name: Curling Machine (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot.
Rest the backs of your arms on the pad and grip the handle.
Curl up fully, squeeze, then lower slowly to almost straight.
tips: Keep the elbows on the pad; do not lift them to finish.

exercises.name: Four Angles Biceps (Panatta)
steps: Choose one of the four arm pad angles and set the seat.
Rest your arms on the pad with elbows at the pivot.
Curl the handles up, squeeze, then lower slowly.
tips: Steeper angles give more stretch; use lighter loads there.

exercises.name: Three Angles Biceps Machine (Panatta)
steps: Pick an arm pad angle and set the seat height.
Place your arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Curl up, squeeze, then lower under control.
tips: Stop just short of full lockout to keep tension on the biceps.

exercises.name: Alternate Arm Curl (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so elbows align with the pivots and select the weight.
Rest your arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Curl one or both arms up, then lower slowly.
tips: Alternate arms to focus on each side's squeeze.

exercises.name: Triceps Machine (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Extend the arms fully, squeeze, then return slowly.
tips: Keep the upper arms still on the pad the whole time.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Fit Evo; Monolith

exercises.name: Standing Total Arms (Panatta)
steps: Set the arm for curls or pushdowns and select the weight.
Stand close with elbows at your sides and grip the handle.
Curl up or push down fully, then return slowly.
tips: Pin the elbows to your sides; do not use your body.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl Bench (Panatta)
steps: Set the seat so your armpits rest on top of the pad.
Hold an EZ bar or dumbbell with arms on the pad.
Curl up, then lower slowly to almost straight.
tips: Do not drop into full lockout fast; it strains the elbow.

exercises.name: Super Squat Machine (Panatta)
steps: Step in under the shoulder pads and set your feet on the platform.
Release the safety lever and stand tall.
Squat down to a good depth, then drive back up.
tips: Feet low on the plate hit quads; feet high on the incline hit glutes.
exercises.line: Free Weight Special; Free Weight HP (Squat machine)

exercises.name: Super Pendulum Squat (Panatta)
steps: Set the footplate angle and step under the shoulder pads.
Place feet mid-plate and release the safety.
Lower deep with knees forward, then press back up.
tips: Keep your back flat on the pad as you go deep.
